definitions.explanation: A person descended from a particular ancestor; future generations.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{武士|ぶし}の{子孫|しそん}だ。
examples.english: He is a descendant of samurai.

examples.japanese: {子孫|しそん}に{良|よ}い{環境|かんきょう}を{残|のこ}したい。
examples.english: I want to leave a good environment for future generations.

examples.japanese: この{家系|かけい}は{子孫|しそん}{繁栄|はんえい}を{願|ねが}って{建|た}てられた。
examples.english: This house was built with wishes for the prosperity of descendants.

notes:
{子孫|しそん} refers to descendants or future generations of a family line.

Common collocations:
- {子孫|しそん}を{残|のこ}す (to leave descendants)
- {子孫|しそん}{繁栄|はんえい} (prosperity of descendants)
- {子孫|しそん}に{伝|つた}える (to pass down to descendants)
- 〜の{子孫|しそん} (descendant of ~)

Antonym: {先祖|せんぞ} / {祖先|そせん} (ancestor)

Related words:
- {末裔|まつえい} (descendant - more literary)
- {後裔|こうえい} (descendant - formal)
- {子々孫々|ししそんそん} (descendants for generations)
